cases.scope: Build and deliver the complete lightweight source BIM and its viewer from all six supplied floor-plan and elevation drawings. Preserve physical rooms, partitions, every opening's host and connectivity. Use one shared building origin and the current 0.1 m regularization policy, retaining original observations, evidence and explicit assumptions. Work with the whole drawing set in this single context. Complete the necessary comparisons, repairs and delivery for this scope; choose diagnostics for specific questions and preserve genuine evidence limits. Do not describe unresolved required work as complete. There is no run-level time deadline. No developer assistance will be provided.
